name: Incentive Scheme for Establishment of New Super Specialty Hospital in Private Sector
benefit:
> **Capital Subsidy**

- 10% of bank loans for medical equipment (max ₹10 crore).
- Disbursed post-hospital operationalization.

> **Interest Subvention**

- 4% interest relief on loans up to ₹40 crore for 7 years.
- Paid in 6 annual installments after a 1-year grace period.

> **Electricity Duty Reimbursement**

100% reimbursement for 5 years (quarterly claims).
> **Employment Generation**

Manda
_eligibility_text: > **The Following Entities Are Eligible** - Registered Doctors (Gujarat Medical Council). - Partnership Firms, Companies, Trusts, Societies, Cooperatives. > **Hospital Requirements** - 50+ Total Beds,including 10+ Super Specialty Beds. - Covers Specialties Like Cardiology, Neurology, Oncology, etc. (List Expandable by Government). > **Loan Conditions** - Only Loans for Construction/Equipment (Excludes Land/Working Capital).
